clips.title: The story
paras: Oggleflint is the chieftain of the trogg tribe dwelling within the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm directly beneath Orgrimmar. His troggs have been creeping up from the lava-filled tunnels toward the surface, and from his place near the cavern's entrance he commands a savage pack that poses an immediate threat to the Horde capital above.

Oggleflint and his troggs climbed out of the fiery tunnels deep beneath Orgrimmar and into Ragefire Chasm. Brutal and territorial, they carved out a primitive domain among the molten rock. Though troggs possess little in the way of advanced civilization, Oggleflint maintained absolute authority over the pack through sheer brute strength.
